## Institutional invariants

- [ ] CrownThrive OS remains the institution-wide source of truth
- [ ] Component versions remain independent from the OS umbrella release
- [ ] Phase 3 is not used as blanket production certification
- [ ] `HOLD` is not converted to `PASS` by prose or version promotion alone
- [ ] Historical records are preserved and clearly separated from current instruction
- [ ] Downstream PentaDocs/web projections do not override OS state
- [ ] D3/new sovereign or equivalent reserved authority remains separately governed

## Rights, IP, culture, and canon

- [ ] Chain of title / license scope checked where applicable
- [ ] CIE/canon/source-community review addressed where applicable
- [ ] CHLOM rights/licensing/evidence authority addressed where applicable
- [ ] Protected identities, minors, likeness, voice, or confidential source boundaries addressed
- [ ] No third-party or restricted material was submitted without authority
- [ ] LICENSE / Phase 3 machine-use / trademark impact considered

## Security, privacy, and data

- [ ] Visibility/data class recorded
- [ ] No secrets or restricted records are exposed
- [ ] Role/purpose/retention/export/deletion implications addressed where applicable
- [ ] Security finding or authority reduction produces HOLD/fail-closed behavior where required
- [ ] Rollback, recovery, or correction path is recorded

## Commerce and economics

- [ ] Product, price, payment, order, entitlement, license, refund, dispute, commission, royalty, and allocation states remain distinct
- [ ] Provider payment evidence is not represented as CrownThrive economic/rights authority by itself
- [ ] Economic schedules or activation are separately versioned and authorized

## API, MCP, provider, and deployment

- [ ] Provider/product/version/environment evidence is current
- [ ] Authentication/scopes/data classes/events/failure behavior are recorded where material
- [ ] Provider capability is not represented as provider-wide CrownThrive write authority
- [ ] Operation-level certification remains narrower than general provider mutation
- [ ] API/MCP side effects, approval classes, and rollback/compensation are explicit
- [ ] Deployment/readback state is not inferred from source acceptance alone

## Archive and projection

- [ ] Superseded/deprecated/historical material has a recorded disposition and successor where known
- [ ] Historical bodies were not rewritten to manufacture current truth
- [ ] PentaDocs/docs-site changes are treated as downstream OS projection work
- [ ] Website/storefront/media projection work is deferred unless explicitly in scope

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_docs.py` where applicable
- [ ] `python3 scripts/pentadocs_quality.py --check` for PentaDocs changes
- [ ] Audience, page type, content state, and standard version resolve in the page-profile registry
- [ ] Frontmatter supplies the H1; body headings begin at H2 and do not skip levels
- [ ] Components communicate structure or state and are not decorative substitutes for explanation
- [ ] Provider rendering/readback remains separate from source-quality validation
- [ ] Scope-specific validators/tests completed
- [ ] Diff reviewed for unrelated changes
- [ ] Internal links and repository references verified
- [ ] Secret/template-residue checks pass
- [ ] Version/release manifests are internally consistent
- [ ] Release/deployment readback will be verified before any live claim
